correctness.rationale: For i≤j, multiplication gives K_ij=Σ_{k≥j}a_k²−(i+1)a_i a_j. Telescoping Σ_{k≥j}g_k=a_j and 1−(i+1)a_i=αa_i give K=Σ d_k v_kv_k*+αaa*, with finite positive trace Σ(k+1)d_k and a∈ℓ². In the invertible partial-sum coordinates of the leading N-dimensional space the positive part has diagonal weights d_0,…,d_{N−2},D_{N−1}; the corresponding coefficient vector is (g_0,…,g_{N−2},a_{N−1}). This gives the exact dual norm squared and, after positive congruence, the required inertia including the simple null direction at equality. The N=1 interior sum is empty and the positive trigamma tail is still exact. Strict increase follows by splitting the merged tail: the first ratio g_{N−1}/d_{N−1}=N+α is strictly less than the d-weighted average of g_k/d_k=k+α+1 for k≥N. The harmonic part diverges; this supplies a negative direction for every −1<α<0 and rank one bounds the full negative index by one. For α≥0 the two terms are positive semidefinite. Uniformly for small ε, the scalar is log N+2−ψ(2−ε)+O(1/N); bounded sections cannot cross 1/ε, and the crossing integers squeeze log N_*−1/ε to −1−γ. The witness partial sums equal k+α+1 up to L−1 and vanish thereafter, giving B_L(1+α B_L), and the same squeeze without the tail term gives 1−γ and the ratio e². Its actual support dimension is L+1, with no change to the limiting ratio. The supplied checker was inspected, not executed: it checks selected exact-rational identities and interval signs with the infinite tail enclosed; the all-N and limiting claims rest on the proof.
residual_risks: The finite checker is not a proof of either limiting statement. The theorem concerns compressions of the full self-commutator, not self-commutators computed after compressing C_α.

None of those observations is treated as an independent novelty here.
residual_risks: Best-knowledge assessment; an unindexed older quantitative result or an equivalent compression formula in different notation is not excluded. The dates of matching catalogue records alone are not evidence of priority.

value.rationale: Leading sections are a canonical diagnostic for nonhyponormality. The result resolves exactly when this diagnostic first succeeds, including equality and a sharp exponential prefactor that is invisible to both eventual negativity and finite sampling. The e² gap quantifies the cost of restricting attention to the known test vector and isolates the role of the infinite tail.
residual_risks: No analogous statement for higher orders, nonleading sections, or the magnitude of the negative eigenvalue is inferred.
